bead.title: agent-loop: document EventPlanningTurn in AGENTS.md (and FEAT-001 if in-scope)
bead.description:
AR-2026-05-17-repo finding. AGENTS.md §Event emission enumerates 8 ServiceEvent types but internal/core/agent.go:219 declares EventPlanningTurn (emitted at internal/core/loop.go:226 when req.PlanningMode=true). Either document the event in AGENTS.md (preferred if planning is a kept feature) or extract planning to an explicit feature spec.

Source review: fizeau-584abce2.
bead.acceptance: Either AGENTS.md §Event emission lists EventPlanningTurn with a one-line description of when it fires, OR the planning code path is gated behind a documented build tag/experimental marker. grep for 'EventPlanningTurn' in AGENTS.md returns at least one hit.
